raw_segments.text: You thought you were as dead as a herring two hours since and you are all alive and
Carter has done with you or nearly so.
I'll make you decent in a trice.
Jane, he turned to me for the first time since his re-entrance.
Go down into my bedroom and walk straight forward into my dressing room.
Open the top drawer of the wardrobe and take out a clean shirt and neck handkerchief.
Bring them here and be nimble.
